description: Typed TypeScript SDK for the Reconify Public API with retries, timeouts, cancellation, cursor pagination, structured errors, and generated OpenAPI types.
rules: Prioritize ingesting integrity events as the primary SDK workflow; show ingestion before read-only listing or reconciliation workflows.
Import the SDK from @reconifyhq/sdk; do not import internal source files.
Create ReconifyClient with an apiKey and baseUrl, and never hardcode credentials in source code.
Use client module properties such as client.events, client.ledger, client.reconciliations, and client.issues.
Pass typed path, query, headers, body, and request options through each operation's single argument object.
Use iterateEvents, iterateIssues, or iterateWalletTransactions for cursor-paginated collections where those helpers exist.
The SDK intentionally excludes deep reconciliation adjustment, lifecycle, evidence, report-item, and signoff operations.
